gaps.sentence: He apologized for ___ so abrupt in the meeting.
We expect ___ the results by Friday.
gaps.explanation: expect takes the to-infinitive: expect to receive.
too + adjective + to-infinitive: too young to stay.

gaps.sentence: The teacher advised us ___ the essay twice.
gaps.explanation: advise + object + to-infinitive: advised us to check. (advise + -ing is possible without object: advise checking.)

gaps.sentence: We mustn't miss ___ this exhibition — it ends on Sunday.
Remember ___ your passport to the airport.
gaps.explanation: remember + to-infinitive = not forget to do something.

gaps.sentence: She was the first woman ___ the peak in winter.
gaps.explanation: the first/second/last + to-infinitive: the first woman to climb.

gaps.sentence: He suggested ___ a taxi instead of walking.
gaps.explanation: suggest + -ing (no infinitive with a person: suggest that we take is also possible).
